## What it is

This is a series of essays I wrote during my time at Chemeketa Community College (2021-2023). These are very early works and may be a little rough around the edges. That said, I recall spending a lot of time thinking about these topics and writing them with great care. I have split up the essays under their main topics. My goal with this is to show that some of these topics have been long on my mind (social-emotional learning, mainly). They also serve as artifacts of my emerging writing style.

## Social Emotional Learning
- 📄 [Emotional Intelligence: A Possible Longterm Solution to School Shootings](com218-final-essay.pdf)
